patch_description: This replaces the genetic population search with a vectorized deterministic continuation optimizer. It optimizes many candidate configurations simultaneously using analytic gradients of a smooth soft-min approximation to the minimum triangle determinant. The smoothing temperature is progressively reduced, turning the objective from a broad landscape into the true nonsmooth maximin objective. Points are projected into barycentric simplex coordinates after every update, while the three enclosing-triangle vertices remain fixed. This avoids expensive selection/mutation cycles and directly follows active minimum-area constraints.
